verdict.rationale: SolidJS components are plain functions that run once and manage local reactive state via signals, with automatic dependency tracking, and can be composed via JSX/Context/Portals into complex UIs, per first-party docs and corroborated by hands-on community reports (e.g., porting react-bootstrap, building large production apps). Minor gaps exist around ergonomics (props-as-functions quirk) but the core encapsulation/composition capability is well evidenced. Missing for 10: independent benchmark/case study specifically isolating component-composition patterns beyond anecdotal HN comments.
